Coseno mínimo para que un hecho del graf: Minimum cosine for a graph fact or an episode fragment to enter the recall; if nothing reaches it, the recall comes back empty instead of filling up with the least distant. A fragment sharing two terms with the query enters with 0.08 less. It depends on the embedding model: calibrate it with the reference queries. 0: no threshold.
Similitud mínima (coseno) de un hecho o: Minimum similarity (cosine) for a fact or a fragment to enter; by default, the instance's; 0 = no threshold.
Similitud mínima de un hecho o un fragme: Minimum similarity of a fact or a fragment
